## Problem

What are you trying to do that the app doesn't support today?

## Proposed solution

What would you like to happen?

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds or other approaches you thought about.

## Note on scope

Meshly is intentionally minimal — see the goal in `README.md`. Feature
requests that add significant complexity for a narrow use case may be
declined in favor of keeping the app simple.
